tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Life Scientific crop-protection catalogue. Filter by free-text query (brand name, tagline, active ingredients, crops and pests), product type, crop, pest/disease/weed target, and/or market/region. Use this for problem-first questions like "what controls septoria in wheat in Ireland?". Ret

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get the full detail for one product by its slug: active ingredients with resistance-group codes (FRAC/HRAC/IRAC), formulation, key uses, and per-market registrations with approved crop/target uses, PHI, pack sizes and safety summary.

tools.name: check_authorization
tools.description: Check whether a product is authorised in a specific market/region and, if so, return its registration status, number, pack sizes and approved uses. Use this to answer "can I use product X in country Y?".

tools.name: get_product_documents
tools.description: Get the current regulatory documents for a product — the official product label and safety data sheet (SDS) per registered market, with download URLs and versions. Labels are market-specific: always use the document for the market where the product will be applied.
